The launcher statically links these libraries. Their source archives and SHA-256 digests are pinned in [dependencies.json](dependencies.json).

| Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [QuickJS-ng](https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/tree/v0.11.0) | v0.11.0 | [MIT](LICENSE-QuickJS.txt) |
| [MinHook](https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/tree/v1.3.4) | v1.3.4 | [BSD-style, including its bundled notices](LICENSE-MinHook.txt) |

Both license files are included in the BAT's extracted package. The project license covers the mod's original code, not the game or its artwork.
